Home › GTA 6 What PS5 and Xbox Consoles Are in Stock Ahead of GTA 6?
 Most models are in stock at MSRP right now.
 By  Chris Reed Updated : Nov 18, 2026 5:01pm UTC Add IGN on Google 0 16 We're on the eve of the release of Grand Theft Auto 6 , which means many new and lapsed gamers are no doubt wondering whether it's time to buy a new game console. If the universal acclaim for the game (including our 10/10 review ) has your interest piqued, you might be wondering what your options are.
 The stock situation has seemed pretty dire in recent months. Xbox head Asha Sharma recently said there’s more demand than Xbox consoles available , and Microsoft told Xbox owners to trade in their dusty consoles . Meanwhile, over on the other side of the aisle, Sony wants to buy your PS5 for $400 , and anyone in the market for a PS5 Pro may have to shell out as much as $1,400 to a reseller to get one.
 So which consoles are available to buy right now? To answer that question, I visited all the major online retailers one day before GTA 6's release to see what's what. And what I found was, with a couple of notable exceptions, most models of every current console are available at manufacturer-suggested retail price (MSRP). Let's dive in.

That's thanks in large part to the parts shortages caused by the rush to build AI data centers. But if you can swing it, it’s not hard to find a new game console at retail price – unless you want a PS5 Pro or Xbox Series X. It's unlikely these consoles will get discounts during PlayStation's Black Friday sale this year .

 We’ve seen a lot of evidence over the years suggesting Xbox console sales are lagging badly behind PS5. The most recent hint that this is the case came from Capcom, which says only 8.6% of Resident Evil Requiem sales were on Xbox . But if you’re willing to throw in with Microsoft anyway, you can get an Xbox Series X at MSRP at most of the usual retailers, with the exception of Best Buy and Xbox directly.

 Nintendo seems to have plenty of Switch 2 consoles on hand, but if you’re curious about how much it costs and where to get it, you can check out the links above. Like PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, it’s widely available at MSRP.
 With all that said, if you’re considering picking a new game console this holiday season, you may want to do it sooner rather than later. It’s absolutely quite possible that Sony and Microsoft are simply looking ahead at the Black Friday sales rush when issuing their warnings about stock. It’s possible a bunch of GTA 6 fans will rush out to get a console when the game launches on November 19 (preloads start November 10, by the way). 
 And it’s looking like RAMageddon will only get worse in 2027 , meaning we could see further console shortages or price increases in the near future. So grab a console if you need it, because they’re readily available at the time of this writing.
